reviewsSection.title: Real Reviews from Real Learners
reviewsSection.description: Here is what our students have to say about learning, building projects, and transforming their careers with DO PILOT.

items.name: Rahul Verma
items.comment: DO PILOT completely changed how I learn programming. In week two, we built actual automation bots instead of reading textbook theory. The 1-on-1 mentor code reviews gave me the exact skills I needed to land my job.

items.name: Ananya Sharma
items.comment: What sets DO PILOT apart is that the instructors are active software engineers. Whenever I ran into backend bugs in Node or React state issues, they helped me debug and explained the underlying system.

items.name: Karthik Nair
items.comment: The data science track is gold. We cleaned raw real-world datasets and integrated OpenAI endpoints into actual tools. My GitHub portfolio from this course was the highlight of my technical interview.

items.name: Sneha Patel
items.comment: I joined one of their weekend live classes and was amazed by the hands-on quality. No boring presentations—just live building and instant Q&A. I learned more in 2 hours than a month of self-study.

items.name: Devendra Singh
items.comment: The focus on clean code and production deployment made all the difference. Building real projects with TypeScript and PostgreSQL helped me clear 3 technical interviews in my first month after graduating.

items.name: Meera Krishnan
items.comment: Outstanding curriculum. Writing actual scraping scripts and chaining AI models opened so many doors. The mentors are available whenever you need help debugging complex workflows.
